tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search job listings by keyword, location, type, or remote policy. Returns paginated results with title, company, salary, and application URL.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get full details of a job listing by its slug or ID, including description, requirements, company info, and application link.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Fetch the latest news articles. Optionally filter by category, locale, or title keyword. Returns title, summary, publication date, and URL.

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: List all content categories available on the platform (for filtering news, jobs, etc.).

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search companies on the platform. Returns company name, industry, location, size, website, and open roles count.

tools.name: get_platform_stats
tools.description: Get high-level statistics about the Datronis platform: total active jobs, jobs indexed in the last 7 days, companies, countries represented, news articles, and users.

tools.name: apply_to_job
tools.description: Submit a job application on behalf of the authenticated user. Requires a personal access token (generate one at /app/api-keys/). If no resume_id is given, your default (or most recently updated) resume is used automatically.

tools.name: list_my_resumes
tools.description: List the authenticated user's saved resumes. Requires a personal access token (generate one at /app/api-keys/).

tools.name: get_my_applications
tools.description: Check the status of the authenticated user's job applications. Requires a personal access token (generate one at /app/api-keys/).

tools.name: draft_news
tools.description: Draft and publish a news article. Open to anyone with a Datronis account — the personal access token is for rate-limiting and audit, not permission-gating. tools.description: Revise and reclassify a news article that draft_news (or a previous resubmit_news call) rejected as "flagged". tools.name: get_missing_news_translations
tools.description: List published English news articles and which locale codes they are still missing a translation for. Pass locale to focus on one language at a time. Use this to find work for submit_news_translation — this tool only reports gaps, it never translates anything itself.

tools.name: submit_news_translation
tools.description: Publish your own translation of an already-published English article into a new locale. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_news · Private data: apply_to_job, list_my_resumes, get_my_applications, draft_news · Public sink: apply_to_job, draft_news, submit_news_translation, admin_create_news.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_news · Private data: apply_to_job, list_my_resumes, get_my_applications, draft_news · Public sink: apply_to_job, draft_news, submit_news_translation, admin_create_news

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
